name: St. John's Co-Cathedral Caravaggio Tour
description: Step inside this seemingly modest cathedral to be stunned by the opulent gold-leaf interior. You will view Caravaggio's masterpiece, 'The Beheading of Saint John the Baptist', hanging in its original oratory setting. It is an essential immersion into Malta's Knight-era artistic heritage.
duration_note: Advance booking recommended for peak season; modest attire required.

name: Upper Barrakka Gardens Sunset Lookout
description: Walk to the highest point of the city walls to watch the sunset over the Grand Harbour. You will see the historical Three Cities across the water glowing in the golden light. It is the perfect spot for photography and soaking in the strategic history of the port.

name: Three Cities Dghajsa Harbour Tour
description: Board a traditional Maltese Dghajsa wooden boat for a private tour through the labyrinthine Grand Harbour. You will get a unique water-level perspective of the fortifications of Birgu, Senglea, and Cospicua. It is a slow-paced, atmospheric way to understand the island's naval significance.
duration_note: Negotiate the price with the boatman before boarding.

name: Traditional Pastizzi Tasting at Caffe Cordina
description: Sit in a historic cafe and order a plate of warm, flaky pastizzi filled with ricotta or mushy peas. It is the quintessential Maltese snack and a cultural rite of passage. Pair it with a strong coffee while watching the city life pass by in the piazza.

name: Rabbit Stew (Stuffat tal-Fenek) at Legligin
description: Indulge in Malta's national dish, slow-cooked rabbit stew, served in a cozy, cavernous wine bar. You will taste the deep, rich flavors of the wine-based sauce combined with local root vegetables. It is a hearty, authentic culinary experience you must try at least once.
duration_note: Reservation required for the tasting menu.

region: Sliema, St. Julian's & The North Coast
name: SS Rozi Wreck Scuba Dive
description: Descend into the Mediterranean to explore the famous SS Rozi shipwreck, a purpose-sunk tugboat sitting upright on the seabed. You will swim through the decks and encounter rich marine life in crystal-clear waters. This is widely considered one of the top shore-entry wrecks in Europe.

region: Sliema, St. Julian's & The North Coast
name: Sliema to St. Julian's Seafront Promenade Walk
description: Enjoy an invigorating walk along the rugged coastline connecting Sliema and St. Julian's. You will pass by the iconic Balluta Bay church and numerous rock pools where locals swim. It is the best way to soak in the vibrant, modern Mediterranean lifestyle of the north coast.

region: Sliema, St. Julian's & The North Coast
name: Paceville Nightlife Crawl
description: Dive into the heart of Malta's party district, Paceville, where the streets are packed with high-energy clubs and bars. You will experience everything from massive dance floors to intimate cocktail lounges. It is the place to be if you want to experience the modern, youthful side of Malta.
duration_note: Best visited Thursday through Saturday nights.

region: Sliema, St. Julian's & The North Coast
name: Skyroom Rooftop Lounge Cocktails
description: Ascend to the top of the Preluna Hotel for a sophisticated evening with panoramic views of the bay. You will sip expertly mixed cocktails as the lights of the harbour twinkle below you. It is a more relaxed and upscale alternative to the chaos of Paceville.

region: Sliema, St. Julian's & The North Coast
name: Fortina Spa Thermal Suite Ritual
description: Escape to one of Malta's most comprehensive spa centers for a day of rejuvenation. You will rotate between thermal indoor pools, saunas, and steam rooms overlooking the Mediterranean. It is the ultimate way to recover after a week of diving or hiking.

name: Silent City History Walk
description: Wander the narrow, limestone-walled streets of the former capital, Mdina. You will discover why it is called the 'Silent City' as you walk past medieval palaces and hidden courtyards. It is a hauntingly beautiful step back in time, away from the modern bustle.

name: Dingli Cliffs Coastal Trek
description: Hike the rugged trails along the highest point of the archipelago. You will experience panoramic views of the sea and the tiny island of Filfla in the distance. It is a bracing, windy, and visually spectacular outdoor experience, best enjoyed just before dusk.
duration_note: Ensure you wear sturdy shoes; steep terrain.

name: St. Paul’s Catacombs Exploration
description: Descend into a vast underground labyrinth of Roman-era burial sites. You will walk through hauntingly carved chambers that reveal the island’s early Christian and pagan history. It is a fascinating, slightly eerie experience that provides a deep dive into Malta's ancient past.

name: Fontanella Tea Garden Afternoon
description: Relax on the bastions of Mdina with a slice of their legendary chocolate cake. You will look out over half the island while enjoying the breeze and the historic setting. It is a famous spot for a reason—the view and the sweets are equally impressive.

name: Early Bird Blue Lagoon Swim
description: Take the earliest boat to reach the Blue Lagoon before the crowds descend. You will swim in neon-turquoise, shallow water that looks like a tropical paradise. It is vital to arrive by 8:00 AM to enjoy the serenity before the day-tripper boats arrive.

name: Cittadella Fortification Tour
description: Explore the recently restored Citadel in the heart of Gozo. You will walk the towering ramparts for a 360-degree view of the island and visit the ancient cathedral inside. It is a powerful display of medieval defensive architecture and island history.

name: Xwejni Salt Pans Coastal Walk
description: Walk along the ancient, checkerboard salt pans carved into the limestone rock face. You will learn about the centuries-old tradition of harvesting sea salt, which is still practiced today. It is a uniquely geometric and serene landscape that captures the quiet soul of Gozo.

name: Fresh Seafood Dinner at Xlendi Bay
description: Dine on the water's edge at Xlendi, choosing from the daily catch displayed on ice. You will taste fresh Mediterranean sea bass or octopus prepared in local garlic and herb oil. It is the ultimate laid-back island dining experience as the waves lap against the promenade.

name: Jeep Safari Island Adventure
description: Traverse the rough, unpaved terrain of Gozo in a 4x4, accessing hidden coves and valleys that normal cars cannot reach. You will experience the raw, pastoral beauty of the island away from the paved roads. It is a thrilling way to cover the island's highlights in a single day.

name: Ggantija Megalithic Temples Tour
description: Step back 5,500 years to stand before the oldest free-standing structures in the world. You will marvel at the colossal limestone blocks that make up these prehistoric temples. It is a humbling, awe-inspiring archaeological site that is significantly older than the pyramids of Egypt.
